content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of lean beef, whole‑grain noodles, and vegetables: carrots, broccoli and dark‑green leafy greens (spinach, kale, etc.). It is prepared without sauce, preserving the natural flavors of the ingredients and reducing added sugar and salt.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Beef is a rich source of iron, zinc, and vitamin B12.
Whole‑grain noodles contain more fiber than regular white pasta.
Broccoli is high in glucoraphanin, a compound that supports the body’s detoxification pathways.
Carrots provide beta‑carotene, which the body converts to vitamin A.
Dark‑green leafy greens are packed with lutein and zeaxanthin, antioxidants beneficial for eye health.

items.title: Supports muscle mass
items.content: Beef protein aids muscle growth and repair, especially for active individuals.

items.title: Boosts immune function
items.content: Zinc and vitamin B6 from beef help maintain a healthy immune system.

items.title: Bone health
items.content: Calcium and vitamin K from leafy greens contribute to bone mineralization.

items.title: Eye health
items.content: Beta‑carotene from carrots and lutein from greens protect eyes from oxidative stress.

items.title: Reduces risk of chronic disease
items.content: Fiber from noodles and antioxidants from vegetables help regulate blood sugar and lower inflammation.

items.title: Excessive red meat intake
items.content: Consuming large amounts of beef may increase cardiovascular risk; moderation is advised.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: If the noodles contain wheat, people with celiac disease should choose a gluten‑free alternative.

items.title: Foodborne illness
items.content: Beef should be cooked thoroughly to avoid salmonella or other bacterial infections.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the dish hot as a complete meal. It reheats well in the microwave or on a skillet. For variety, add fresh herbs, a squeeze of lemon, or a drizzle of olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared dish in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3‑4 days. It can be frozen for up to 2 months. Reheat to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C before eating.
